#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

struct InputReader {
    InputReader() {}
    int nextInt() {
        int x = 0, sign = 1, c;
        while ((c = getchar()) != EOF && (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t'));
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = getchar(); }
        for (; c >= '0' && c <= '9'; c = getchar()) x = x * 10 + c - '0';
        return x * sign;
    }
};

class Blossom {
    vector<vector<int>> graph;
    int n;
    vector<int> match, p, base;
    vector<bool> used;

    int lca(int a, int b) {
        vector<bool> seen(n, false);
        while (true) {
            a = base[a];
            seen[a] = true;
            if (match[a] == -1) break;
            a = p[match[a]];
        }
        while (true) {
            b = base[b];
            if (seen[b]) return b;
            b = p[match[b]];
        }
    }

    void markPath(int u, int curbase, int child, vector<bool>& blossom) {
        for (; base[u] != curbase; u = p[match[u]]) {
            blossom[base[u]] = true;
            blossom[base[match[u]]] = true;
            p[u] = child;
            child = match[u];
        }
    }

    int findPath(int root) {
        fill(p.begin(), p.end(), -1);
        iota(base.begin(), base.end(), 0);
        fill(used.begin(), used.end(), false);
        queue<int> q;
        used[root] = true;
        q.push(root);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int v : graph[u]) {
                if (base[u] == base[v] || match[u] == v) continue;
                if (v == root || (match[v] != -1 && p[match[v]] != -1)) {
                    int curbase = lca(u, v);
                    vector<bool> blossom(n, false);
                    markPath(u, curbase, v, blossom);
                    markPath(v, curbase, u, blossom);
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (blossom[base[i]]) {
                            base[i] = curbase;
                            if (!used[i]) {
                                used[i] = true;
                                q.push(i);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (p[v] == -1) {
                    p[v] = u;
                    if (match[v] == -1) return v;
                    int nxt = match[v];
                    used[nxt] = true;
                    q.push(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

public:
    Blossom(const vector<vector<int>>& graph) : graph(graph), n(graph.size()) {
        match.assign(n, -1);
        p.resize(n);
        base.resize(n);
        used.resize(n);
    }

    int maxMatching() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (match[i] == -1) {
                int v = findPath(i);
                while (v != -1) {
                    int pv = p[v];
                    int ppv = match[pv];
                    match[v] = pv;
                    match[pv] = v;
                    v = ppv;
                }
            }
        }
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int x : match) if (x != -1) cnt++;
        return cnt / 2;
    }
};

void solve() {
    InputReader in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    if (n > m) swap(n, m);
    long long V = (long long)n * m;

    if (V < 100) {
        int v = (int)V;
        vector<vector<int>> g(v);
        for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
            int r1 = i / m;
            int c1 = i % m;
            for (int dr = -3; dr <= 3; dr++) {
                for (int dc = -3; dc <= 3; dc++) {
                    if (abs(dr) + abs(dc) == 3) {
                        int r2 = r1 + dr;
                        int c2 = c1 + dc;
                        if (r2 >= 0 && r2 < n && c2 >= 0 && c2 < m) {
                            g[i].push_back(r2 * m + c2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Blossom blossom(g);
        int pairs = blossom.maxMatching();
        cout << pairs * 2 << endl;
    } else {
        long long res;
        if (n == 1) {
            res = m / 6 * 6 + (m % 6 == 4 ? 2 : 0) + (m % 6 == 5 ? 4 : 0);
        } else {
            res = V;
            res -= res % 2;
        }
        cout << res << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
